source: source clouds transformed using operator mount; processed clouds analyzed separately
phase_windows: 30 s clean baseline; 30 s confirmed stationary reflector; >=30 s after removal acknowledgement
reflector_reference: deepest central foil point; conservative physical bounding box extends depth toward radar and half width/height sideways/vertical
physical_removal_timestamp: bounded between removal request and operator acknowledgement; no exact action timing claimed
occupancy_semantics: TTL to unknown; clutter can refresh cells after target removal
